name: Dify Widget Vanilla
description: Custom, fully themeable floating Dify chatbot block that streams the Dify Chat API through a server-side proxy so the API token never reaches the browser.
project_description: Dify Widget Vanilla is a submodule of the Dify project. It provides a placeable Drupal block plugin (DifyWidgetVanillaBlock, id dify_widget_vanilla_block) that renders a fully custom, themeable floating chatbot backed by the Dify Chat API. All Dify calls go through a server-side ProxyController: the block's base URL and API token are saved to Drupal State keyed by a per-block state_key UUID, and the browser only talks to Drupal proxy routes (chat-messages, messages, parameters, suggested, feedbacks) which forward to Dify with the token attached server-side. Streaming answers use the base module's DifyChatProxyService (Server-Sent Events over native curl); markdown is rendered through the base module's MarkdownController. The block exposes ~20 CSS color variables served as dynamic CSS through a hash-validated route, plus title, placeholder, markdown theme (light/dark), an accessibility skip link, and overridable bot/user avatars in Twig. Conversation history is kept in the browser's localStorage. POST proxy routes are protected with a CSRF request-header token. Requires the dify base module and league/commonmark ^2.8.
